note: Regional park on the Carrot River south of Carrot River town, off Hwy 23: grass sites under mature trees beside a 9-hole golf course, with a pool, mini golf, restaurant and the fossil interpretive centre. Mostly seasonal: about 41 of its 106 sites are sold by the night; a tenting area and a non-electric overflow area add more. --Claude
summary: Keep. Regional parks page + operator: 106 electrified 30 A sites (65 seasonal, 41 daily = 39% nightly) + tenting/non-serviced; 2026 $36 a night (non-serviced $25), $10 entry; season May 8 - Oct 3, 2026; reservations by email/phone. Not waterfront kept, pin fine. Google 4.4 / 57.
flags: LONG-STAY: 'There are 106 electrified, well treed sites, 65 seasonal and 41 daily sites' (SRP page) -> 39% nightly (more counting the tenting area and non-serviced sites). Posted nightly rate ($36) and a reservation channel; operator invites nightly guests ('Book for a night, a week, a month...'). Google Maps 4.4 from 57 reviews (the place covers the whole park incl. golf). Kept with the mostly-seasonal note.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. The camping rows (around 53.1891,-103.5835) are ~350 m north of the Carrot River bend behind the golf course and ~80 m south of a small treed creek valley (Esri z16). No site near open water.
PIN: no move; stored 53.18910,-103.58350 sits in the camping rows. The regional-parks page's GPS (53.18835,-103.58758) is the Hwy 23 entrance ~280 m W.
PHONE: stored 306-768-3239 matches the operator office line. No change. (Winter phone (306) 276-3924 per SRP.)
WEBSITE: stored https://www.pasquia.com/ fine; suggest adding https://saskregionalparks.ca/park/pasquia/ (holds the fees and season). pasquia.com/campsite-map returns 404 (map page gone).
SITES: stored count 41 was the daily-site count; now 106 electrified (65 seasonal / 41 daily).
FEES: park entry '$10.00 per day' left in fees.note, not fees.entrance - the page does not say per vehicle or per person.
